name: Mishima Yukina
source:
[b]【The Ambitious Flight Attendant】[/b]

A stewardess who flies international routes for a certain airline.

Her entire lifestyle is high-end and status-driven—the quintessential "high-maintenance woman."

Because of her extreme elitist mindset—believing that "a man without money or status isn't a man at all"—she became a target for "re-education" by the "Japan Women's Re-education Organization."
